resolutions.description: One resolution per conflicting group set investigated.

conflict_id.description: The conflict_id from the input that this resolution addresses.

resolution.description: Resolved action. MERGE: combine groups into one. SPLIT: separate into distinct groups with different signals. KEEP_SEPARATE: keep as separate groups that are theoretically related.

rationale.description: Detailed justification (2-5 sentences) grounded in evidence observed through CWM tools or provided data. Reference specific incidents examined and the behavioral logic that supports this resolution.

affected_groups.description: The groups affected by this resolution, with their new disposition.

source_batch.description: Batch index of the original local group.

original_signal.description: Original signal from the local group.

action.description: What happens to this group. merged_into: combined with another group. split_to: separated into a distinct group. kept_as: retained with possibly renamed signal. discarded: removed.

target_signal.description: If merged_into or split_to: the signal of the target group. If kept_as: the new signal (may be unchanged). Empty string if discarded.

evidence_sources.description: List of tools called and evidence gathered during investigation.

tool.description: The CWM tool called, or 'provided_data' if evidence came from the input context.

query.description: What was queried (incident ID, search text, document ID).

finding.description: Key observation from the tool output that informed the resolution (1-2 sentences).

confidence.description: Confidence in this resolution. HIGH: clear evidence from multiple sources. MEDIUM: evidence supports but some ambiguity remains. LOW: weak evidence, decision is judgment-based. UNCERTAIN: tools unavailable or insufficient data, best-guess resolution.

suggested_global_signal.description: If resolution is MERGE or KEEP_SEPARATE: suggested signal for the resulting global group(s). If SPLIT: suggested signals for the separated groups, as a comma-separated string.
